sentences.zh: 俄，託合齊得罪，五十一年，起廷樞工部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon Tuheqi fell from grace; in the fifty-first year Tingshu was recalled as minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tuheqi fell; in the fifty-first year Tingshu was recalled as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 江南總督噶禮、江蘇巡撫張伯行互訐，命尚書張鵬翮、總督赫壽按治，議奪伯行官。

translations.literal: Jiangnan Governor-General Gali and Jiangsu Governor Zhang Boxing impeached each other; Ministers Zhang Penghe and Governor-General Hesou were ordered to investigate and proposed stripping Boxing of office.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Gali and Jiangsu governor Zhang Boxing impeached each other; Zhang Penghe and Hesou investigated and proposed stripping Boxing.

sentences.zh: 上復命廷樞與尚書穆和倫覆勘，如鵬翮等議。

translations.literal: The emperor again ordered Tingshu and Minister Mu Helun to reinvestigate, agreeing with Penghe and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Tingshu and Mu Helun to reinvestigate; they agreed with Penghe.

sentences.zh: 疏下九卿，上特命奪噶禮官，伯行復任。

translations.literal: When the memorial went to the Nine Ministers, the emperor specially ordered Gali stripped and Boxing restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial reached the Nine Ministers, the emperor specially stripped Gali and restored Boxing.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year he moved to justice.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，河南宜陽知縣張育徽加徵火耗虐民，盜渠亢珽結澠池盜李一臨據神垕寨為亂，並劫永寧知縣高式青入寨；

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year Yiyang magistrate Zhang Yuhui of Henan extorted melting-fee surcharges and abused the people; bandit chief Kang Pei joined Mianchi bandit Li Yilin in occupying Shenwei Stockade in revolt and also seized Yongning magistrate Gao Shiqing into the stockade;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year Henan's Yiyang magistrate Zhang Yuhui extorted melting fees; bandit Kang Pei joined Li Yilin at Shenwei Stockade, seized Yongning magistrate Gao Shiqing, and rebelled;

sentences.zh: 閿鄉盜王更一亦藉知縣白澄豫徵錢糧，嘯聚圍縣城；

translations.literal: Wenxiang bandit Wang Gengyi also, relying on magistrate Bai Chengyu's tax exactions, gathered a crowd and besieged the county seat;
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiang bandit Wang Gengyi, aided by magistrate Bai Chengyu's tax squeezes, gathered men and besieged the county seat;

sentences.zh: 巡撫張聖佐、總兵馮君侁不能平，又匿不以起釁所由入告。

translations.literal: Governor Zhang Shengzuo and Commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the trouble in their reports.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Shengzuo and commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and hid the origins of the revolt in their reports.

sentences.zh: 命廷樞與內閣學士勒什布按治，珽自縊；

translations.literal: Tingshu was ordered with Grand Secretariat academician Leshibu to investigate; Pei hanged himself;
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu and academician Leshibu were ordered to investigate; Kang Pei hanged himself;

sentences.zh: 更一、一臨就擒，置之法；

translations.literal: Gengyi and Yilin were captured and punished by law;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gengyi and Li Yilin were captured and executed;

sentences.zh: 澄、育徽擬絞監候；

translations.literal: Chen and Yuhui were sentenced to strangulation deferred;
translations.idiomatic: Bai Chen and Zhang Yuhui were sentenced to deferred strangulation;

sentences.zh: 聖佐、君侁奪官；

translations.literal: Shengzuo and Junqian were stripped of office;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shengzuo and Feng Junqian lost their posts;

sentences.zh: 並追咎原任巡撫李錫令屬吏加徵激變，論斬。

translations.literal: and former governor Li Xiling was also pursued for ordering subordinates to increase levies and incite rebellion, sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: former governor Li Xiling was pursued for ordering extra levies that sparked rebellion and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 蘭陽白蓮教首袁進等謀不軌，命廷樞並按，論罪如律。

translations.literal: Lanyang White Lotus leader Yuan Jin and others plotted sedition; Tingshu was ordered to investigate jointly and sentenced by law.
translations.idiomatic: Lanyang White Lotus leader Yuan Jin plotted sedition; Tingshu investigated jointly and sentenced by law.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，南陽鎮兵為亂，辱知府沈淵，命廷樞偕內閣學士高其倬按治；

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year Nanyang garrison troops mutinied and insulted prefect Shen Yuan; Tingshu was ordered with academician Gao Qizhuo to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year Nanyang troops mutinied and insulted prefect Shen Yuan; Tingshu and Gao Qizhuo were sent to investigate;

sentences.zh: 浙江巡鹽御史哈爾金受商人賕，被劾，命廷樞偕內閣學士德音按治。

translations.literal: Zhejiang salt censor Haerjin took merchants' bribes and was impeached; Tingshu was ordered with academician Deyin to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang salt censor Haerjin took merchants' bribes; Tingshu and Deyin were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 並論如法。

translations.literal: All were sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: All were sentenced according to law.

sentences.zh: 廷樞還京師，疏言：「河南漕米自康熙十四年每石改折銀八錢解部，嗣因米賤，部議以一錢五分解部，餘交巡撫購米起運。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, Tingshu memorialized: "Henan transport grain since Kangxi fourteen was commuted to eight qian silver per picul paid to the ministry; later because grain was cheap the ministry ordered one qian five fen to the ministry and the rest to the governor to purchase grain for transport."
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital Tingshu wrote: "Since Kangxi 14 Henan grain tax was commuted to eight qian silver per picul for the ministry; when grain grew cheap the ministry took one qian five fen and left the governor to buy grain for transport."

sentences.zh: 巡撫分委州縣，州縣复派民買輸，甚為閭閻累。

translations.literal: The governor delegated to prefectures and counties, and counties again assigned the people to buy and deliver, greatly burdening neighborhoods.
translations.idiomatic: "Governors delegated to counties, and counties pressed the people to buy and deliver—a heavy neighborhood burden."

sentences.zh: 請交糧道購運，毋得派累民間。

translations.literal: He asked that the grain circuit purchase and transport and that the people not be assigned the burden.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the grain circuit to purchase and transport without pressing the people.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and enacted it.

sentences.zh: 世宗在籓邸，優徐采嗾傭者箠殺人，部議以傭抵。

translations.literal: When the future Yongzheng Emperor was still in his princely mansion, his favored follower Xu Cai instigated a hired man to beat someone to death; the ministry proposed the hired man answer for it.
translations.idiomatic: While the future Yongzheng Emperor was still a prince, his follower Xu Cai had a hired man beaten to death; the ministry proposed the hired man answer.

sentences.zh: 廷樞獨議罪在採，坐徙邊。

translations.literal: Tingshu alone held guilt lay with Cai and sentenced him to frontier exile.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu alone held Cai guilty and sentenced him to frontier exile.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，褒廷樞抗直，复逮採論罪。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor took the throne, he praised Tingshu's upright resistance and again arrested Cai for sentencing.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongzheng took the throne he praised Tingshu's firmness and rearrested Cai for sentencing.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，以原任編修陳夢雷侍誠郡王得罪，命發黑龍江，廷樞循故事，方冬停遣，又出其子使治裝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, because former compiler Chen Menglei had served Prince Cheng and offended, he was ordered sent to Heilongjiang; Tingshu followed precedent and, as it was winter, suspended dispatch, and also released his son to prepare baggage.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 former compiler Chen Menglei, who had served Prince Cheng, was ordered to Heilongjiang; Tingshu followed precedent, suspended winter dispatch, and let his son prepare baggage.

sentences.zh: 尚書隆科多劾廷樞徇縱，命鐫五級，逐回籍。

translations.literal: Minister Longkeduo impeached Tingshu for indulgence; he was ordered demoted five ranks and expelled to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Longkeduo impeached Tingshu for lenience; he was demoted five ranks and sent home.

sentences.zh: 子縉，進士，官中允，亦以告病家居。

translations.literal: His son Jin, a jinshi and palace reader, also stayed home on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jin, a jinshi and palace reader, also stayed home ill.

sentences.zh: 六年，陝西巡撫西琳劾廷樞受河督趙世顯贓六千，抗追不納，縉居鄉不法。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Shaanxi Governor Xilin impeached Tingshu for taking six thousand taels in bribes from River Commissioner Zhao Shixian and refusing pursuit, and Jin for lawlessness at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Shaanxi governor Xilin charged Tingshu with taking six thousand taels from river commissioner Zhao Shixian and refusing repayment, and Jin with lawlessness at home.

sentences.zh: 詔奪廷樞及縉官，令所司嚴訊。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Tingshu and Jin of office and ordered strict interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped both of office and ordered strict interrogation.

sentences.zh: 廷樞被逮，道卒。

translations.literal: Tingshu was arrested and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu was arrested and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 總督岳鍾琪議縉當斬，籍其家，詔特寬免，令縉在川、陝沿邊修城贖罪。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yue Zhongqi proposed Jin should be decapitated and his property confiscated; an edict specially pardoned him and ordered Jin to redeem guilt by repairing walls along the Sichuan-Shaanxi border.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yue Zhongqi proposed executing Jin and confiscating his property; the throne specially pardoned him and ordered wall repair on the Sichuan-Shaanxi border as redemption.

sentences.zh: 乾隆時，复廷樞官，追諡文端。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign Tingshu's office was restored and he was posthumously titled Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong his office was restored and he received the posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 子綖，亦進士，官戶部主事。

translations.literal: His son Yuan, also a jinshi, was principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yuan, also a jinshi, was a revenue principal secretary.

sentences.zh: 論曰：維訥論貪吏遇赦，不得遽复官；

translations.literal: The commentator says: Weine argued that corrupt officials meeting amnesty must not immediately regain office;
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Weine held that corrupt officials pardoned by amnesty must not immediately return to office;

sentences.zh: 克溥言民生疾苦，戒加賦濫刑；

translations.literal: Kepu spoke of the people's hardships and warned against increasing levies and abusive punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Kepu spoke of popular hardship and warned against heavier taxes and abusive punishment;

sentences.zh: 鴻儒請定歲會之制；

translations.literal: Hongru asked to fix the annual accounting system;
translations.idiomatic: Hongru urged a fixed annual budget;

sentences.zh: 楗議兵後當復行計典；

translations.literal: Jian urged that after war the great review should be resumed;
translations.idiomatic: Jian urged resuming the great review after war;

sentences.zh: 裴請禁殉葬：益於國，澤於民，言各有所當也。

translations.literal: Pei asked to forbid funeral sacrifice: each benefited the state and favored the people, and each spoke to the point.
translations.idiomatic: Pei asked to forbid burial sacrifice—all spoke to the point and benefited state and people.

sentences.zh: 廷樞使車四出，惟張伯行事出上裁，他皆稱指。

translations.literal: Tingshu sent investigating carriages in four directions; only in Zhang Boxing's case did the outcome depend on the emperor's decision—in other matters he hit the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu sent investigators in every direction; only Zhang Boxing's case awaited the emperor—in others he judged rightly.

sentences.zh: 律嚴科場罪，所以重取士，乃草野私議輒以為過甚。

translations.literal: The law is strict on examination-hall crimes to honor selection of scholars, yet private talk in the wilds often calls it excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Law is strict on examination crimes to honor scholars, yet common talk often calls it excessive.

sentences.zh: 克溥興丁酉順天之獄，卒以不謹罷，殆怨家所中歟？

translations.literal: Kepu stirred the Dingyou Shuntian case and in the end was dismissed as not diligent—was he perhaps struck by enemies?
translations.idiomatic: Kepu stirred the Dingyou Shuntian scandal and was dismissed as not diligent—perhaps enemies struck home?

sentences.zh: 廷樞得罪，似亦有齮之者，詘而後申，足為謇直者勸矣。

translations.literal: Tingshu fell from grace as if someone had slandered him; humbled and later vindicated, enough to encourage the forthright.
translations.idiomatic: Tingshu fell as if slandered; humbled then vindicated—enough to hearten the forthright.
